entities.name: Pre-State Tribal Society & Pagan Culture

entities.summary: Lithuanian tribal society on the eve of state formation: the šventaragiai (sacred groves), the romuva religious traditions, resistance to early Crusader incursions, and the decentralised rule of kunigaikščiai (dukes) over the Lithuanian tribes.
